description: ISPS Havneanlegg is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kystverket. Datasettet inneholder beskrivelse av havneanlegg som Kystverkets fører tilsyn med etter den såkalte ISPS koden. Denne omhandler havnesikring mot ytre trusler/terroranslag: Objektene i datasettet beskrives med ISPS status, hvilken type trafikk som går over havneanlegget samt en del forhold som for eksempel eierskap, myndighet mv. Coverage: Kystverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kystverket. Its keywords include fellesDatakatalog, Sikkerhet, Havneterminal, Havn, Kyst og fiskeri, Norge digitalt. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GML, KML, GEOJSON, OCTET. The listing shows 2014-05-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
